bullets.text: late to three things this week. none of them noticed. i did.
duck hasn't moved from okunoin in six weeks. overcast, warm. the moss did all the moving.
finally answering an email from june. the answer took four minutes. the waiting took eleven weeks.
the vending machine two streets over restocked overnight. same six drinks, different order. somebody chose that.
the kettle and the boiler are arguing about who goes first. the kettle is winning on volume.
